input.reasoning_summary:
All three challenges have been refuted by the newly retrieved evidence, which strengthens the initial SUPPORTED verdict.

H1 challenged whether full-year 2025 showed consistent positive growth across all regions. Evidence E7 from the 2025 10-K definitively shows that all four geographic regions experienced positive revenue growth for the full year 2025: US & Canada (+21%), Europe (+24%), Asia-Pacific (+20%), and Rest of World (+27%). Evidence E8 shows similar positive growth across all regions in Q2 2025. This refutes any concern about regional declines.

H2 challenged whether growth was concentrated in one or two regions rather than truly broad-based. The evidence shows balanced growth rates across all regions (ranging from 20% to 27% for full year 2025), with no single region dominating. While E14 shows that US & Canada and Asia-Pacific are the largest revenue contributors in absolute terms, the growth rates were relatively consistent across all regions, supporting the "broad-based" characterization.

H3 challenged whether any region experienced significant declines or challenges. The evidence clearly shows all regions had strong positive growth throughout 2025, with no geographic revenue declines reported.

The initial verdict of SUPPORTED remains correct. The claim that Meta's revenue growth in 2025 was broad-based across geographic regions is fully supported by evidence showing positive growth in all four reported geographic regions for both the full year and individual quarters of 2025.
